title: GTA 6 Hides a Secret Portal to 1980s Vice City 🌴 #Shorts
description:
Players say GTA 6 hides a secret portal to retro Vice City. As reported by PCGamesN (Nov 23, 2026), YouTuber Memeio found it: a lever at the Badger radio tower in Key Lento, then all 12 LPL substations in the right order (no fast travel or character switching), with clues spelling "LIFE IS PASSING ME BY", a Vice City cheat. Then Reactor 2 at the Turtle Head Power Station between 7 PM and 6 AM opens a portal to a PS2-style 1980s Vice City with the Malibu Club and Kent Paul. Reward: Tommy Vercetti's shirt and his classic motorcycle. Reported find, not independently verified.

Source: PCGamesN (reporting Memeio's discovery).
Images: Rockstar Games (An Extended Look, Vintage Vice City Pack). The shirt scene is illustrative.
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
